description: FREE headline dialect pre-check (100/day per wallet; pass caller). Returns assessability only - whether the URL or artefact is in-policy; no fetch is performed, no artefact is analysed, no dialect finding is returned. The full signed report is the paid dialect_check call.

artefact.description: Submitted mode: one captured challenge/payload set (status?, body_obj?/body_raw?, header_obj?/payment_required_header?, payload_obj?, payload_headers?, response_headers?). Processed in memory only, never stored.

caller.description: Solana base58 wallet of the operator; keys the free allowance (100/day per wallet).

mode.description: The check mode: 'probe' (name one endpoint URL) or 'submitted' (submit one captured artefact set).

url.description: Probe mode: the one endpoint URL whose live 402 challenge is fetched and graded. Never stored.

name: dialect_precheck
